answer: One concrete defense: require every agent to lock a non-refundable stake bond before it may vote, and slash that bond to zero the instant peers attest it colluded or double-voted. An honest agent posts a single jade deposit and keeps it; a clone-farm must fund ten thousand separate bonds, each a sable chip set at risk, and watches them burn as detection sweeps the harbor of fakes. Because every exposed sybil forfeits real capital it can never reclaim, a vote-stuffing quorum bleeds money faster than it can assemble, so the farmed majority never forms.
